Name: ChestItemFinder
Author: cynthiazhao0411
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
ChestItemFinder helps you find which chest holds the item you're looking for. Open a search box, and matching chests pulse in the world. An on-screen message tells you how many chests were found and in which locations. Built for late-game farms where you have too many chests to remember what's in each one.



[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Download the zip and extract the ChestItemFinder folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Load a save and press LeftShift + T to open the search box. Type the item name and press Enter.
*(You can change the search key in `config.json` or in-game if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed.)*


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
Search all chests in every location, including building interiors (sheds, barns) and Ginger Island.Press LeftShift + T to open a clean in-game search box instead of typing console commands.Smart Auto-Suggest: Real-time dropdown suggestions, including category tags.Recent Searches: Quick access to your search history, with a one-click clear button. History remembers your exact quality filter.Multi-term Search: Search multiple items at once using commas or spaces (e.g., fruit, fish).Number ID Translation: Searching by ID (e.g., 268 or -4) automatically translates to readable names in the results and history.Advanced Smart Matching: Category macros (e.g. fruit), exact matches (e.g. star fruit), and fuzzy fallback (e.g. star).Quality Filter System: Cycle quality (Any, Silver, Gold, Iridium, No Quality). Items without quality (like wood) ignore this filter and show a special empty star icon.Keep Highlights Feature: Check the box in the result panel to permanently keep chests highlighted even after the panel fades.Smart UI Flipping: The result panel and Keep Highlights box automatically flip to the top or bottom depending on your toolbar position, never blocking your view.Hover Tooltip & Pause: Hover over location text to see item counts. Hovering over the UI pauses the highlight countdown.Highlights automatically clear after opening a target chest or when the timer runs out.Fully customizable via GMCM: 10 colors, opacity slider, timeout settings, custom keybind, and a reset button.[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0 or later
- Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional, to change the default H keybind in-game)
